newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares rise across board in steady trade.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares rise across board in steady trade.

text.p: Stockholm's bourse posted gains on Wednesday morning, boosted by a rise in New York overnight and lower debt yields at home in the wake of a positive inflation report on Tuesday.
The Stockholm general index rose 0.92 percent to 2,279.85 after shares worth 1.63 billion crowns were traded.
Brokers said the market was not waiting for any particular economic statistics and the market was not expected to be that active during the day.
"The rise is steady but I think however that a certain degree of uncertainty still remains," said one broker.
"There is no reason that Sweden will fare better than any other European bourse," said another broker.
Bluechip stocks were higher with telecoms giant Ericsson up 3.5 crowns at 200 and drugs major Astra rising 1.5 to 322.5 crowns.

The bank index was 1.21 percent higher. Insurer Skandia fell 3.5 to 188.5 crowns after on Tuesday withdrawing its merger proposal with Stadshypotek. Rival suitor Handelsbanken rose three to 193 crowns. Stadshypotek was steady at 186.5 crowns.
